summary.zh: 内测与整体验收进行中，尚未达到稳定正式版
summary.en: Internal testing and full acceptance in progress; not yet a stable release

boundary.zh: 以下是项目验收记录，不是当前网站的实时健康状态。代码更新、本地验证与线上部署分别记录。
boundary.en: This is an acceptance record, not live site health. Code updates, local verification and deployment are tracked separately.

name.zh: 动态、知识库、家族与图谱

implemented.zh: 完整浏览、筛选和关联入口保留。
implemented.en: Browsing, filtering and linked navigation are retained.

verified.zh: 新网址主要页面与筛选、搜索、对比、跨页入口已检查；未据此宣称全部业务场景通过。
verified.en: Main pages, filters, search, comparison and linked navigation checked at the new address; this does not establish all business scenarios.

implemented.zh: 登录、研究保存、修改、历史及报告导出。
implemented.en: Sign-in, research saving, revision, history and report export.

verified.zh: 新网址已验证登录、研究保存、修改保留旧版、重开、Markdown/PDF 下载和手机报告；嵌入字体后的线上 PDF 已逐页检查。
verified.en: Sign-in, saved research, revisions retaining the original, reopening, Markdown/PDF downloads and mobile reports tested online; the embedded-font PDF was downloaded and inspected page by page.

implemented.zh: 事实与证据分离，原文、摘要和未分类文本区分。
implemented.en: Claims and evidence separated; quotations, summaries and unclassified text distinguished.

verified.zh: 14 条渠道事实及 34 条历史范围、版本归属与来源问题已逐项修正，原记录保留并有软件回归；全量语义、时效与生命周期复核未完成。
verified.en: 14 channel claims and 34 historical-scope, model-association and source findings corrected with original records retained and software regressions; full semantic, freshness and lifecycle review remains open.

implemented.zh: 采集、候选审核、发布与通知模块保留。
implemented.en: Collection, candidate review, publishing and notification modules retained.

verified.zh: 已有软件回归；持续更新闭环及邮件实际送达尚未验收。
verified.en: Software regressions tested; continuous update cycle and actual email delivery not yet accepted.

implemented.zh: README、使用说明、项目介绍和验证记录。
implemented.en: README, usage guides, project introduction and validation records.

verified.zh: 前后端已统一从 main 发布；README 与页面共用进度记录，目录修正继续按对应版本发布复验。
verified.en: Frontend and backend deploy from main. README and pages share the status record; catalog corrections continue to receive version-specific release verification.
